$comment: Tier 1 standing posture check parameters. DRAFT for Tony to edit. Every number is a PLACEHOLDER picked so the synthetic neutral posture passes and each synthetic deviation fails; none is a clinical or literature value yet. Sagittal features are taken from the left/right views, frontal ones from the front/back views (see metrics.ts). Distances are meters, angles degrees.

checks.why: Ears should sit roughly over the shoulders from the side. An angle so it holds for any body size (Tony, 2026-10-10): 11° = the old 0.04 m on the synthetic lifter (~0.2 m shoulder to ear).

Shoulders should sit roughly over the hips from the side. Forward = rounded shoulders or thoracic flexion; MediaPipe can't tell which. An angle so it holds for any body size (Tony, 2026-10-10): 4.5° = the old 0.04 m on the synthetic lifter's ~0.5 m trunk.
Knee should not sit far past straight.
Knee should not sit far past straight.
Ears roughly level from the front or back.
Shoulders roughly level from the front or back.
Hip joint centers roughly level. A leg-length or iliac crest check needs palpation, not a camera.
Shoulders centered over the hips from the front or back. An angle so it holds for any body size (Tony, 2026-10-10): 3.5° = the old 0.03 m on the synthetic lifter's ~0.5 m trunk.
Knee close to the hip-ankle line from the front: + is valgus, - is varus.
Knee close to the hip-ankle line from the front: + is valgus, - is varus.
